summary.text: Kellie Deeter is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 54 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. A nurse and small business owner, she is vice chair of the House Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Deeter earned a B.S. in nursing from Bowling Green State University, a master’s degree from the University of Akron and a D.N.P. from Maryville University of St. Louis.

Her career experience includes working as a small business owner, and she has been affiliated with the Ohio State Association of Nurse Anesthetists and the American Association of Nurse Anesthesiology.
She won the 2024 Republican primary for District 54 over Anthony Savage and then defeated Brenda Buchanan and Andrew Leonard in the general election.
In the 2025–2026 session Deeter was assigned to the Arts, Athletics, and Tourism; Children and Human Services; Health (vice chair); and Insurance committees.
